categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in three primary business segments: (1) Urban water environment comprehensive treatment, including municipal wastewater treatment plants, pipeline networks, black odorous water body treatment, and river ecosystem restoration; (2) Industrial wastewater treatment, providing zero-discharge solutions and comprehensive environmental services through its subsidiary Maiwang Environment; (3) Village and township water environment comprehensive treatment, offering integrated solutions for rural sewage treatment and water infrastructure.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include AAO process for high-standard municipal wastewater treatment, SBR process for surface water class IV standard treatment, and advanced oxidation processes. Manufacturing methods encompass EPC (Engineering-Procurement-Construction) contracting, equipment design and manufacturing, and integrated system solutions. The company operates research centers including the Chaohu River Basin Treatment Industry Technology Research Institute and maintains partnerships with over 30 universities and research institutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include municipal governments, environmental management departments, industrial parks, and industrial enterprises. Key end markets are municipal wastewater treatment, industrial wastewater treatment, and rural environmental governance. The company serves customers across more than 20 provinces and municipalities in China, with operations in regions including the Yangtze River Economic Belt, Yellow River Basin, and Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates across multiple regions in China including Anhui (40.71% of revenue), East China (11.72%), South China (6.77%), Central and Southwest China (11.96%), Northwest, North and Northeast China (23.65%), and international markets (4.89%). Major operating bases are located in Hefei, Anhui Province, with additional operations in Shanghai, Wuhan, and other key cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the entire water treatment value chain, functioning as both midstream and downstream operator. It provides design and consulting services (upstream), EPC contracting and equipment manufacturing (midstream), and long-term operational management of wastewater treatment facilities (downstream). The company also operates as a project investor through PPP, BOT, and TOT models.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Low-carbon water operations management and energy efficiency optimization; (2) Smart water management platform development and digital transformation; (3) Industrial wastewater treatment and zero-discharge technology advancement; (4) Integrated watershed management and ecological restoration; (5) Rural water environment comprehensive treatment solutions. R&D focuses on precision control systems, advanced oxidation technologies, and intelligent operation platforms.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple models: (1) Operational services revenue from long-term wastewater treatment facility operations (58.52% of revenue); (2) Engineering construction services through EPC and DBO contracts (37.74% of revenue); (3) Equipment manufacturing and sales (3.44% of revenue); (4) Design and consulting services. Revenue recognition varies by project type, with operational revenue recognized over time and engineering revenue recognized based on project completion progress.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic water treatment operator with over 100 wastewater treatment plants and 519 million tons/day treatment capacity. It ranks among China's top water industry enterprises, having received the 'China Water Industry Top 10 Most Influential Enterprise' award eight times and 'China Environmental Enterprise Top 50' recognition six consecutive times. Main competitors include other large water treatment operators and environmental service companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-to-large scale environmental services enterprise with 2023 revenue of 4.128 billion yuan (0.71% growth from 2022). Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 392.3 million yuan (down 3.11% from 2022), while non-GAAP net profit increased 20.54% to 345.1 million yuan. Total assets reached 15.76 billion yuan. The company demonstrates stable profitability with weighted average ROE of 10.39%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Key differentiators include: (1) Integrated 'technology plus operations' advantage with 20+ years of industry experience; (2) Comprehensive full-chain service capability from design to long-term operation; (3) Advanced proprietary technologies achieving international or domestic leading standards; (4) Strong R&D capability with 295 R&D personnel and multiple technology innovation centers; (5) Central enterprise backing through parent company China Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Group, providing strategic and resource advantages; (6) Specialized expertise in low-carbon operations and smart water management.
